description: MOHELA on mohela.studentaid.gov is a U.S. federal student loan servicing website where borrowers manage loans, payments, repayment plans, and forgiveness-related account tasks. The site provides informational pages, forms, and secure account access for borrowers.
summary: mohela.studentaid.gov appears to expose only a borrower-facing website and secure account portal; no public developer integration surfaces (HTTP APIs, GraphQL, MCP servers, or CLI) were found.
